institution: IIIT Vadodara (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Vadodara)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data)

key_positive_themes.notes: Modern 25-acre Education Hub with dedicated academic buildings, labs, library spaces, and 24/7 wifi; classrooms and hostels described as new and well maintained.
Structured B.Tech curriculum (e.g., CSE via JEE Main) with experienced faculty engaging students in coding, theory, and projects; relatively best-rated category (3.0/5).
Placements described as growing with support from the main IIIT Vadodara placement cell; tech and consulting recruiters and expanding opportunities noted, though from a low base.
Official facilities list includes hostels, gym, sports, medical, digital library, and campus-wide wifi.

key_negative_themes.notes: Despite being established in 2013, IIIT Vadodara still lacks its own permanent campus; classes run out of a single block within Government Engineering College (GEC), Gandhinagar, with limited space not purpose-built for the institute.
Lowest-rated category (2.1/5) — the clear standout weak point compared to all peer IIITs reviewed.
Rated just 2.0/5 — students feel fees are not justified given the temporary, under-resourced infrastructure.
Students express uncertainty about when a permanent campus will be ready, with no clear timeline for major development, dampening overall campus life sentiment.
Rated 2.5/5, below most peer IIITs, though marginally improving at the newer Diu campus.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: IIITVICD is average for Btech — modern 25-acre hub, well-maintained classrooms and hostels, growing placements
I was always hoping for a good campus life — no permanent campus since 2013, classes in a single block at GEC Gandhinagar, space limited
Temporary arrangement serves basic needs but lacks dedicated resources and environment expected from a fully established institute
Speed accessing internet with wifi facility covers all over campus; digital library and hygienic cafeteria available

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Vadodara is the most negative among the IIITs analyzed so far, driven overwhelmingly by the institute's lack of a permanent campus more than a decade after establishment. While academics and the newer Diu international campus show some positive signals, low infrastructure and value-for-money scores reflect real student frustration with the temporary, space-constrained setup.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study.
